title: The Contact of Vienna
author: Ada Nakamura
blurb: Zephyrine Montrose, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
